An '''Ulmatran condor''' was a purple-feathered [[Bird/Legends|bird]], presumably from [[Ulmatra/Legends|Ulmatra]]. [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] wore some feathers of an Ulmatran condor on his head.
